articles.headline: 김 품종 판별을 위한 저렴하고 간편한 다중 PCR 분석법 개발
articles.title: Development of a multiplex PCR assay for the authentication of six commercial
articles.authors: Noh E, Dong C, Park H, Jung H et al.
takeaways: 전 세계 김 시장의 확대에 따라 경제적 동기를 가진 원료 혼입을 막고 종을 정확히 판별할 수 있는 범용적 분석 방법의 필요성이 대두되었습니다.
rbcL 유전자의 종 특이적 단일염기다형성을 타겟으로 한 다중 PCR 분석법은 1.5% 아가로스 겔 상에서 172~781 bp 크기의 계단형 밴드를 형성하며 10 ng/μL의 민감도를 보였습니다.
의도적 미스매치가 도입된 프라이머를 활용한 이 분석법은 복잡한 가공식품 매트릭스에서도 대상 종을 효과적으로 구별해 내어 상용 김 제품의 품질 관리에 활용될 수 있습니다.
articles.implications: 일반 실험실에서도 고가의 장비 없이 54°C의 어닐링 온도 조건만으로 다수 품종의 김과 혼합 제품을 판별할 수 있어, 양식 현장과 유통 관리 기관에서 신속한 원산지 및 품종 검증 수단으로 즉시 도입할 수 있습니다.
articles.abstract: The global expansion of the Pyropia (laver) market requires reliable methods to authenticate species and prevent economically motivated adulteration (EMA). While automated molecular techniques exist, their reliance on specialized instrumentation limits routine application in standard laboratories. We hypothesized that pairing species-specific SNPs within the rbcL gene with mismatch-engineered primers enables the discrimination of closely related Pyropia species without advanced instrumentation. In this study, we developed a multiplex PCR assay targeting the rbcL gene to differentiate six Pyropia species (P. yezoensis, P. tenera, P. dentata, P. haitanensis, P. seriata, and P. suborbiculata). By analyzing 162 rbcL sequences, we identified conserved species-specific SNPs. We designed a primer set comprising six forward primers with intentional mismatches to improve specificity, paired with a single common reverse primer. The optimized assay (annealing temperature of 54 °C) generated a step-wise pattern of amplicons ranging from 172 to 781 bp, which were resolvable on a conventional 1.5% agarose gel. The assay demonstrated species specificity with no cross-reactivity and exhibited an analytical sensitivity of 10 ng/μL of genomic DNA. To validate the method, we tested 20 commercial laver products using a multi-point sampling strategy. The assay authenticated single-species compositions and identified multi-species blends. These results indicate that analyzing multiple regions per sheet is necessary to determine the true composition of commercial products. These findings support our hypothesis that mismatch-engineered multiplex PCR effectively discriminates target species in complex matrices, providing an accessible and practical tool for verifying composition during routine quality control.

articles.headline: 해양 유산균 발효로 극대화된 방풍김의 장 건강 및 항염증 효능
articles.title: Marine-derived lactic acid bacteria fermentation enhances the bioactivity of Neopyropia haitanensis by improving intestinal homeostasis
articles.authors: Liu Z, Chen J, Xu J, Yi H et al.
takeaways: 해조류 기반 식품의 기능성을 높이기 위해 해양 유래 젖산균 3종을 선별하여 방풍김의 발효 효과를 분석했습니다.
발효물은 대장염 마우스 모델에서 체중 감소와 혈변 등 증상을 완화하고, 혈청 IL-6를 낮추며 IL-10을 높이는 동시에 항산화 효소 활성을 개선했습니다.
대사체 분석 결과, 발효 과정에서 증가한 특정 생리활성 대사물들이 항산화 및 장 장벽 기능 회복과 강한 상관관계를 보였습니다.
articles.implications: 현장 양식가와 가공 기업은 해양 유산균 발효 기술을 적용하여 항산화 및 장내 면역 조절 기능이 강화된 고부가가치 해조류 기반 건강기능식품 소재를 개발할 수 있습니다.
articles.abstract: This study investigated the functional fermentation of Neopyropia haitanensis using marine-derived lactic acid bacteria (LAB), aiming to develop effective strategies to improve the bioactivity and functionality of seaweed-based foods. Fifteen LAB strains were isolated from marine sources, among which three strains, namely Pediococcus pentosaceus HYZ2-1, Limosilactobacillus reuteri HYS1-1, and Ligilactobacillus salivarius HYD1-1 with superior fermentation performance, were selected. In vitro cellular assays indicated that the fermented products exhibited antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and intestinal barrier-enhancing effects. Furthermore, in colitis mice, the fermented products alleviated symptoms such as weight loss, hematochezia, and colon shortening, and significantly reduced serum interleukin (IL)-6 levels while increasing IL-10 levels, compared with the unfermented samples. Colon tissues showed decreased malondialdehyde and increased superoxide dismutase and catalase activities. The gene expressions of tight junctions and mucin 2 were upregulated. Metabolomic analysis revealed consistent upregulation of specific bioactive metabolites across all fermented groups, and these metabolites were strongly correlated with the observed improvements in antioxidant capacity, immune modulation, and intestinal barrier integrity. Overall, this study demonstrates the functional advantages of marine-derived LAB in enhancing the bioactivity of N. haitanensis, providing new insights into the development of seaweed-based functional foods, especially for gut health.

articles.headline: 김(Neoporphyra haitanensis)의 성별에 따른 건조 스트레스 적응 전략과 삼투 조절 메커니즘 규명
articles.title: Sex-related osmotic adjustment strategies underpin desiccation tolerance in the intertidal seaweed Neoporphyra haitanensis
articles.authors: Xue S, Chen J, Xiao J, Xin J et al.
takeaways: 조간대 대형해조류가 반복적인 조수 간만 속에서 겪는 건조 스트레스에 대해 성별에 따른 생리적 반응 차이는 그동안 잘 알려지지 않았다.
생리학 및 다중 오믹스 분석 결과, 수컷은 트할로스 합성과 Na+, Ca2+ 배출 능력이 뛰어난 반면, 암컷은 단백질 분해를 통한 아미노산 축적에 의존하는 것으로 나타났다.
N. haitanensis는 유기 삼투질 합성와 무기 이온 수송을 결합한 성별 특이적 삼투 조절 전략을 통해 건조 내성을 유지한다.
articles.implications: 양식 현장에서는 기후변화에 따른 환경 스트레스 속에서 생산성을 높이기 위해 암컷과 수컷의 서로 다른 생리적 특성과 삼투 조절 능력을 고려한 맞춤형 우수 품종 선발 및 관리 전략을 수립해야 합니다.
articles.abstract: Desiccation stress constitutes a significant environmental challenge for macroalgae inhabiting the intertidal zone, in which recurrent tidal cycles shape their physiological tolerance. However, sex-related responses to desiccation in macroalgae remain largely unexplored. In this study, we integrated physiological measurements with transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses to investigate sex-related responses of Neoporphyra haitanensis to desiccation stress. Physiological results revealed that males possessed a stronger osmotic adjustment capacity than females under desiccation. Consistently, non-invasive micro-test results confirmed that males exhibited superior Na+ and Ca2+ extrusion abilities, while maintaining a higher K+ level. Multi-omics further uncovered sex-based molecular strategies to cope with desiccation stress. Males displayed higher trehalose levels with up-regulated expression of trehalose-6-phosphate synthase, the key enzyme in trehalose synthesis. In contrast, females displayed higher proteasome gene expression and greater amino acid accumulation levels, suggesting a reliance on amino acid accumulation driven by protein degradation for osmotic protection. Moreover, males displayed higher transcript levels of ion transport-related genes, including genes encoding sodium/hydrogen exchangers (NHXs) and K+-stimulated pyrophosphate-energized sodium pumps (HppAs), which facilitated toxic ion exclusion and stable K+ retention. Overall, these findings revealed the critical role of sex-specific osmotic adjustment strategies in desiccation tolerance of N. haitanensis, driven by osmotic adjustment strategies integrating organic osmolyte synthesis and inorganic ion transport. This study provides new insights into the sex-related adaptive mechanisms of macroalgae and has valuable implications for understanding population dynamics under environmental stresses and for guiding strain selection in mariculture.

articles.headline: 김 부산물 기반 고안정성 피코에리트린 색소 단백질 제조 공정 개발
articles.title: Structural, color, and stability properties of hydrogen peroxide-treated phycoerythrin-based colorant proteins from dried laver (
articles.authors: Lee J, Kim M, Kim S, An J et al.
takeaways: 마른김 바이오매스의 수용성 단백질을 활용한 해조류 바이오리파이너리 시스템 구축 전략을 모색하고자 했다.
4.5 mol/L 과산화수소로 1.5시간 동안 처리한 결과, 적색도(a*)와 PE/PC 비율이 13.85에 달했으며 단백질 농도는 3.48 mg/mL로 기존 방식 대비 최대 2배 향상되었다.
과산화수소 처리가 유도한 단백질-당류 간 상호작용과 이황화 결합 기반의 응집 구조가 다양한 환경 조건에서 우수한 색소 안정성과 유화 특성을 부여함을 확인했다.
articles.implications: 현장 양식가와 가공 산업계는 본 공정을 통해 버려지는 김 부산물로부터 고부가가치 천연 색소 단백질을 대량 추출하여 식품 산업의 안정적인 천연 착색제 원료로 활용할 수 있다.
articles.abstract: This study aimed to develop a strategy for use of the water-soluble protein fraction extracted from laver biomass to establish a seaweed biorefinery system. By leveraging the oxidative reactivity differences of hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂), a phycoerythrin (PE)-based colorant protein (PBCP) was produced from the water-soluble proteins of dried laver (Pyropia yezoensis). The highest a* value and PE/PC ratio (13.85) for PBCP were achieved after a 1.5 h treatment with 4.5 mol/L H₂O₂. The protein content (3.48 mg/mL) of the PBCP was approximately 1.5-fold to 2-fold greater than that of PE obtained through ammonium sulfate precipitation and ion-exchange chromatography. H₂O₂ treatment induced interactions between proteins and saccharides in the water-soluble protein, causing aggregation through β-structures primarily stabilized by disulfide bonds. These structural changes led to enhanced emulsifying properties and color stability under various temperature, light, and pH conditions. These findings establish PBCP as a stable, seaweed-derived protein pigment for food applications.

articles.headline: 김(Pyropia yezoensis)의 인 부족 극복을 위한 세포외기질 알칼리 포스파타제 메커니즘 규명
articles.title: Functional characterization and periplasmic localization of a phosphorus starvation-induced alkaline phosphatase involved in phosphate acquisition in Pyropia yezoensis
articles.authors: Yoshimizu M, Yamagishi Y, Kuwano K, Miwa Y
takeaways: 방사조피 김은 인이 결핍된 환경에서 인산염을 흡수하기 위해 알칼리 포스파타제 유전자의 전도를 유도합니다.
정제된 76-kDa 크기의 성숙한 효소는 글리세로인산, 당 인산, 뉴클레오사이드 인산 등에 대해 넓은 기질 특이성을 보였으며 Na+, Ca2+, Mg2+에 의해 활성화되었습니다.
이러한 결과는 김이 인 부족 시 세포질 주변 공간에 존재하는 알칼리 포스파타제를 통해 효율적으로 인산을 획득함을 시사합니다.
articles.implications: 양식 현장에서 인 결핍에 따른 김의 생리적 반응 기전을 이해함으로써, 영양염류 최적화를 통한 양식 생산성 향상 및 품종 육종 프로그램의 분자적 지표로 활용할 수 있습니다.
articles.abstract: Expression of the alkaline phosphatase gene in Pyropia yezoensis is transcriptionally induced under phosphorus deprivation. To elucidate its physiological role in phosphate acquisition, we purified the enzyme to homogeneity from phosphorus-starved thalli and characterized its biochemical properties. The alkaline phosphatase exhibited broad substrate specificity toward glycerophosphate, sugar phosphates, and nucleoside phosphates, and its activity was enhanced by Na+, Ca2+, and Mg2+ at concentrations comparable to those in natural seawater. Genomic analyses, together with biochemical characterization, revealed that the gene lacks introns and encodes an N-glycosylated phosphatase with a signal peptide. Immunological and biochemical analyses suggested that the mature 76-kDa enzyme is localized to the periplasm of phosphate-starved thalli. These findings suggest that P. yezoensis acquires phosphate under phosphorus-deficient conditions through a periplasmic alkaline phosphatase-mediated phosphate acquisition system.

articles.headline: 남극 해조류 붉은점토김(Pyropia) 추출물의 강력한 항결핵 및 면역조절 효과
articles.title: Antimycobacterial Activity and Nitric Oxide Production Inhibition of Antarctic Seaweeds
articles.authors: Rosas Fernández C, Simão T, Lasunskaia E, Borges R et al.
takeaways: 다제내성 결핵 치료제 개발을 위해 극지방 환경에 적응한 남극 해조류 지용성 추출물의 항결핵 및 면역조절 잠재력을 조사했습니다.
추출물의 72.4%가 결핵균(Mtb H37Rv)에 항균 활성을 보였으며, 특히 Pyropia endiviifolia 추출물은 표준주와 고독성 균주(M299)에 대해 각각 2.1, 3.2 μg/mL의 우수한 MIC50 값을 기록했습니다.
남극 해조류의 2차 대사산물이 항결핵 치료제로서 최초로 입증되었으며, 펜타데칸산과 콜레스테롤 등이 주요 활성 성분으로 확인되었습니다.
articles.implications: 제약 바이오 산업계와 극지연구소는 남극 극한 환경의 해조류 자원을 활용하여 기존 항생제에 내성을 가진 결핵균을 겨냥한 신규 치료제 개발 후보물질 발굴에 즉각 착수해야 합니다.
articles.abstract: The emergence of increasingly resistant strains of Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) makes the search for new antimycobacterial and host-directed therapies essential to help combat this disease. Antarctica extreme environmental conditions make seaweeds an important source for the discovery of bioactive compounds with the potential to treat various diseases caused by microorganisms. In this study, 29 lipophilic extracts of Antarctic seaweeds were evaluated for their potential as antituberculosis drug sources. The antimycobacterial and immunomodulatory activities (based initially on NO inhibition), as well as the chemical profiles of the algae were studied. Of all the extracts, 21 (72.4%) showed antimycobacterial activity with MIC50 values lower than 25 μg/mL against Mtb H37Rv. And, 9 (31%) showed activity also against the hypervirulent strain Mtb M299. Regarding immunomodulation, 27 seaweed extracts (93.1%) inhibited NO production by suppressing iNOS expression with IC50 values lower than 25 μg/mL. Six samples of the genera Desmarestia, Sarcopeltis, Iridaea, Pyropia, and Curdiea with dual activity and a selectivity index higher than ten were selected as promising, with Pyropia endiviifolia extract standing out against Mtb H37Rv and Mtb M299 (MIC50 2.1 ± 0.2 and 3.2 ± 0.7 μg/mL, respectively). GC-MS-based Molecular Networking indicated pentadecanoic acid, hexadecanoic acid, and cholesterol as the major known components of the promising samples. Our study demonstrates for the first time the potential of the secondary metabolites from Antarctic seaweeds against Mtb and encourages further investigation to characterize novel antitubercular agents from these extremophilic organisms.

articles.headline: 식용 해조류의 단백질 소화율과 세포벽 구조의 상관관계 규명
articles.title: In vitro protein digestibility assessment in edible seaweeds: Methodological approach and species comparison
articles.authors: Díaz-Piñero L, Correa Y, Bojorges H, Martínez J et al.
takeaways: 복잡한 세포벽 구조로 인해 해조류의 단백질 생체이용률이 제한될 수 있어, 개량된 INFOGEST 프로토콜을 통한 체계적인 소화율 평가가 시도되었습니다.
적조류인 Porphyra dioica가 45~60%로 가장 높은 단백질 소화율을 보였으며, 그 뒤를 Saccharina latissima와 Ulva lacinulata가 이었고 동결건조는 소화율을 낮추는 경향을 보였습니다.
다당류 구성과 세포벽 아키텍처가 효소 접근성을 결정하며, 정확한 측정을 위해서는 매트릭스 특이적 대조군의 설정이 필수적임이 밝혀졌습니다.
articles.implications: 현장 양식가와 가공업자는 단백질 흡수율을 높이기 위해 전통적인 동결건조 방식에서 벗어나 세포벽 파괴를 최소화하는 맞춤형 전처리 공정을 도입해야 하며, 후속 연구에서는 단백질-자유 공시료 보정을 의무화하여 측정의 정확도를 높여야 합니다.
articles.abstract: Seaweeds are promising sustainable alternative protein sources, however, their complex cell wall structures may limit protein bioaccessibility. This study evaluated the in vitro protein digestibility of three seaweeds, Ulva lacinulata (green), Porphyra dioica (red), and Saccharina latissima (brown), applying the INFOGEST protocol specifically adapted for seaweed matrices. The influence of preservation methods (freezing vs freeze-drying) was also assessed. Compositional and multi-scale structural characterization of the seaweeds before and after digestion was performed to understand their digestive behaviour. Protein digestibility differed significantly among species, with Porphyra dioica showing the highest values (45-60%), followed by Saccharina latissima (20-35%) and Ulva lacinulata (10-30%). These differences were linked to variations in polysaccharide composition and cell wall architecture, which influenced enzyme accessibility. Freeze-drying generally reduced digestibility, likely due to processing-induced structural changes that may reduce protein accessibility. Additionally, digestibility values were strongly affected by the formulation of the protein-free blanks, highlighting the importance of matrix-specific controls in the in vitro protocol. Overall, this work provides new insights into the relationship between seaweed composition and structure, and protein bioaccessibility, contributing to a more accurate evaluation of seaweeds as alternative protein sources and supporting the development of tailored processing strategies to enhance their nutritional value.

articles.headline: 기계학습 기반 발굴을 통한 고효율 자외선 차단 물질 포피라-334 생합성 효소 확보
articles.title: Machine learning-assisted discovery of AdMysD for enhanced porphyra-334 biosynthesis
articles.authors: Yuan L, Feng S, Xie S, Liu Q et al.
takeaways: 자외선 차단 물질인 MAA 생합성의 속도 제한 효소인 MysD는 기존에 기능적 주석이 부족하여 전통적인 기계학습을 적용하기 어려웠습니다.
서열 유사성 네트워크와 딥러닝 등을 결합한 데이터 기반 탐색 파이프라인을 통해 후보군을 42개로 압축하고, 아파노테케 헤게왈디이(Aphanothece hegewaldii) 유래 AdMysD를 발굴하여 기존 기준 효소 대비 포피라-334 생산 촉매 효율을 3배 향상시켰습니다.
발굴된 AdMysD 효소는 다양한 기질 수용성을 보여주며 희소 효소 패밀리를 효율적으로 탐색할 수 있는 생물촉매 도구와 전략을 제시했습니다.
articles.implications: 기능적 데이터가 부족한 해양 미생물 효소 발굴에 긍정-비표지(PU) 학습 기법을 적용하여 고부가가치 자외선 차단 소재인 MAA의 산업적 대량 생산 공정을 구축하는 데 활용할 수 있습니다.
articles.abstract: Mycosporine-like amino acids (MAAs) are functional secondary metabolites renowned for their exceptional UV protection, antioxidant properties, and environmental resilience. In the MAA biosynthetic pathway, MysD is the pivotal enzyme mediating the chemical transition of the cyclohexenone core into a cyclohexenimine-type scaffold. This MysD-catalyzed secondary amino acid modification not only dictates the chemical diversity of MAAs but also facilitates a crucial bathochromic shift, moving the UV absorption maximum from the UVB range into the high-penetration UVA region. Despite its significance, MysD remains the rate-limiting step in the biosynthesis of iminomycosporine-like amino acids. To date, only eight MysD enzymes have been heterologously validated, with even fewer subjected to biochemical characterization, which severely restricts the use of conventional supervised machine learning for enzyme discovery. In this study, we developed an integrated, data-driven screening framework combining Sequence Similarity Networks (SSN), deep representation learning (UniRep), and Positive-Unlabeled Bagging (PU Bagging) to explore the MysD functional landscape. This pipeline effectively compressed the search space from approximately 951 unannotated homologues to a prioritized 42 candidates. Experimental validation led to the discovery of AdMysD from Aphanothece hegewaldii, which exhibited a 3-fold increase in catalytic efficiency for porphyra-334 production relative to the previously established benchmark, NlMysD. Notably, while demonstrating a primary preference for l-Thr, AdMysD displayed significant substrate promiscuity by accepting l-Ser, l-Ala, and l-Cys to produce iminomycosporine derivatives. Our findings provide a biocatalytic tool for the efficient production of MAAs and demonstrate the potential of a PU-learning-based prioritization strategy for identifying rare enzyme families with sparse functional annotations.

articles.headline: 김·톳의 무기비소 현장 검출을 위한 동결건조 무세포 바이오센서 개발
articles.title: Field-deployable, lyophilized cell-free biosensor for robust and selective detection of inorganic arsenic in complex seaweed matrices
articles.authors: Jeong D, Kim T, Cha M, Lee H et al.
takeaways: 기존의 현장 비소 모니터링은 콜드체인 의존도와 생물안전 위험 때문에 한계를 겪고 있다.
ArsR 규제 유전자 회로를 적용한 센서는 무기비소와 유기비소를 효과적으로 구분하며, 동결건조를 통해 상온에서 4주간 약 70%의 활성을 유지하고 배경 노이즈를 액상 대조군 대비 8배 줄였다.
실제 해조류 추출물 검증을 거친 이 콜드체인 프리 고감도 플랫폼은 분산형 식품 안전 모니터링과 환경 스크리닝을 크게 진전시킬 수 있다.
articles.implications: 현장 양식가와 가공업체는 냉장 시설 없이도 유통 단계에서 해조류의 독성 무기비소를 즉시 선별하여 안전성을 확보할 수 있으며, 규제 기관은 복잡한 전처리 없이 신속한 현장 검수 도구로 활용할 수 있다.
articles.abstract: Current on-site arsenic monitoring is hindered by cold-chain dependence and biosafety risks. We developed a field-deployable cell-free protein synthesis (CFPS) biosensor for the rapid, selective detection of toxic inorganic arsenic in seaweed matrices (Sargassum fusiforme and Porphyra sp.). An ArsR-regulated genetic circuit enables effective discrimination between inorganic and organic arsenic species. A tailored lyophilization strategy eliminated the need for ultra-low temperature storage, retaining ∼70% activity over four weeks at room temperature. Notably, freeze-drying serendipitously suppressed leaky expression, reducing background noise by 8-fold compared to liquid controls. Validated through spike-and-recovery tests in real seaweed extracts, this cold-chain-free, highly sensitive platform represents a significant advancement for decentralized food safety monitoring and environmental screening.

articles.headline: 방사무늬김 다당류의 황산기 함량이 항동결성에 미치는 영향과 기전 규명
articles.title: Physicochemical characterization, antioxidant and antifreeze properties of Porphyra haitanensis polysaccharide fractions
articles.authors: Liu Y, Wang Y, Han L, Peng X et al.
takeaways: 방사무늬김 유래 다당류 분획의 화학적 조성과 항산화 및 항동결 특성 간의 상관관계를 밝히고자 했다.
알코올 침전 농도가 낮아질수록 황산기 함량이 증가하여, 동결 효모 세포 생존율이 4.38%에서 82.20%로 크게 향상되었다.
황산기 함량이 높은 다당류는 수소결합 계면 변화를 통해 얼음 결정 형성을 억제하며 뛰어난 항동결 효과를 발휘한다.
articles.implications: 냉동 식품 산업 및 세포 보존 분야에서 합성 부동액을 대체할 천연 생물학적 항동결제로 김 유래 다당류를 적극 활용할 수 있는 가공 공정 설계가 요구된다.
articles.abstract: This study aims to reveal the antifreeze and antioxidant properties of Porphyra haitanensis polysaccharide (PHP) fractions, and to elucidate their relationship with the chemical composition of PHP. With the decrease of alcohol precipitation concentration (75%-45%), the content of sulfate groups (SG) in PHP fractions increased, and their antifreeze effect increased. Specifically, the frozen yeast cells viability increased from 4.38% to 82.20%, and the fermentation capacity of frozen yeast cells increased from 1.92 cm to 2.53 cm. Through correlation analysis, it was found that SG was positively correlated with antifreeze properties, but not with antioxidant activity. Additionally, molecular dynamics simulations showed that polysaccharides with higher SG content enhanced ice crystal inhibition and antifreeze activity by changing the arrangement of the polysaccharide water interface. These results illustrate that the composition of PHP fractions is related to their antifreeze protection effect, and they have potential as cell and food antifreeze agents.

articles.headline: 김 로스팅 과정 중 대사물질 변화와 항산화 능력의 상관관계 규명
articles.title: Roasting-induced changes in the metabolite profile of laver (
articles.authors: Song S, Chae S, Cho S, Kim H et al.
takeaways: 방사무늬김(Neopyropia yezoensis)의 로스팅 온도와 시간에 따른 비휘발성 대사물질의 변화를 분석하고자 본 연구가 수행되었습니다.
열처리가 강화될수록 마이코스포린 유사 아미노산(MAAs)은 초기값의 0.08배로 감소한 반면, 탈수된 MAAs는 1.22~13.61배 증가했고 ABTS와 FRAP 항산화 활성도 각각 최대 4.55배, 4.18배 높아졌습니다.
탈수된 MAAs의 확장된 공액 구조와 전자 비국소화가 라디칼 안정화를 촉진하여 항산화 활성을 강하게 유도하는 것으로 확인되었습니다.
articles.implications: 현장 가공 공정에서는 항산화 효능을 극대화하기 위해 탈수 MAAs 생성 조건을 타겟으로 한 정밀한 로스팅 온도 및 시간 제어 프로토콜을 도입할 필요가 있습니다.
articles.abstract: This study investigated non-volatile metabolites in laver (Neopyropia yezoensis) roasted under different temperature/time conditions. Ultra-performance liquid chromatography-quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometry-based metabolomics identified 69 metabolites, including mycosporine-like amino acids (MAAs) and their dehydrated derivatives. Multivariate analysis showed that dehydrated MAAs were among the key roasting-responsive metabolites. As roasting intensity increased, MAAs decreased to 0.08-fold of the initial value, while dehydrated MAAs increased 1.22- to 13.61-fold. Antioxidant activity increased, with ABTS+ radical scavenging activity and FRAP exhibiting maximum increases of 4.55- and 4.18-fold, respectively. Pearson's correlation analysis revealed strong positive associations (r > 0.93) between dehydrated MAAs and antioxidant activity. This pattern is consistent with the extended conjugation and enhanced electron delocalization of dehydrated MAAs, which may facilitate radical stabilization. These findings provide insight into metabolite and antioxidant activity changes during roasting and offer fundamental data for optimizing roasting conditions.

articles.headline: 김속 7개 품종의 전장 엽록체 게놈 분석과 고품질 핵 DNA SSR 마커 개발
articles.title: Comparative plastome analyses and genomic resource development for five Neoporphyra haitanensis and two Neopyropia yezoensis cultivars based on genome skimming data
articles.authors: Zhang C, Gao Z, Wang H, Zhou W et al.
takeaways: 형태적 변이가 크고 분자 자료가 부족한 방사무늬김과 둥글김의 품종 식별을 위해 게놈 스키밍 기법을 활용했다.
방사무늬김 엽록체 게놈은 201,110~201,310 bp로 둥글김(191,974 bp)보다 컸으며, 7개의 초가변 영역과 다수의 핵 SSR 마커를 발굴했다.
201개의 공유 단백질 코딩 유전자를 이용한 계통 분석을 통해 두 종의 독립적인 진화 경로와 종내 유전적 차이를 명확히 입증했다.
articles.implications: 현장의 양식가와 육종가는 이번에 확보된 종 특이적 바코드와 대규모 SSR 마커를 활용하여 우수 종자를 정확히 판별하고 분자 육종의 효율성을 극대화할 수 있습니다.
articles.abstract: Neoporphyra haitanensis and Neopyropia yezoensis are two economically important seaweeds in Asia, yet their germplasm identification is often hindered by high phenotypic plasticity and limited molecular resources. To address this, we utilized a genome skimming strategy on five No. haitanensis and two Ny. yezoensis cultivars to retrieve their plastome information (including whole plastome sequences, plastome-divergent hotspots, and plastome-derived SSRs) and to identify genome-wide polymorphic nuclear SSRs. The plastomes of No. haitanensis (201,110-201,310 bp) were markedly larger than those of Ny. yezoensis (191,974 bp), a difference largely driven by expansions in intergenic regions. Gene annotation identified 253 genes in No. haitanensis and 256 in Ny. yezoensis, with the latter uniquely containing two additional hypothetical ORFs (ORF33 and ORF35) and an extra rRNA gene (rrfB). Further comparative analysis revealed seven hypervariable regions (π > 0.1), five of which-apcE-tatC, psbW-trnR, psbX-accD, trnW-rpl11, and ycf32-rpl32-are intergenic spacers with strong potential as species-discriminatory barcodes. We also characterized 26-30 chloroplast-derived SSRs and identified notable interspecific variations in their repeat-type profiles. Importantly, we developed 230 and 505 high-quality polymorphic nuclear SSRs for No. haitanensis and Ny. yezoensis, respectively, predominantly trinucleotide repeats, offering a robust toolset for fine-scale genetic analyses. Phylogenetic reconstruction using 201 shared plastid protein-coding genes clearly separated the two species into distinct clades, supporting their independent evolutionary trajectories, and further revealed intraspecific genetic differentiation, particularly with the cultivar ZD-1 forming a distinct branch within No. haitanensis. This study provides comprehensive genomic resources-including complete plastomes, hypervariable regions, and polymorphic SSR markers-that will facilitate germplasm identification, phylogenetic studies, and molecular breeding in Porphyra sensu lato.

articles.headline: 방사무늬김에서 발굴된 Formin 유전자 가족의 환경 스트레스 반응 분석
articles.title: Identification and Expression Analysis of the Formin Gene Family in
articles.authors: Ye S, Ji H, Chen L, Qi J et al.
takeaways: 조간대에 서식하는 경제적 홍조류 방사무늬김에서 액틴 조절 인자인 Formin 유전자 가족의 기능과 스트레스 반응은 아직 잘 알려지지 않았다.
방사무늬김 유전체에서 3개의 Formin 유전자가 확인되었으며, 이 중 NpyFormin01은 24°C의 고온 처리 조건에서 유의미하게 발현이 증가했다.
단백질 구조와 발현 양상의 차이는 Formin 유전자들의 기능적 분화를 시사하며, 특히 NpyFormin01은 고온 적응을 위한 핵심 후보 유전자임을 밝혔다.
articles.implications: 기후변화에 따른 해수온 상승 대응 양식 품종 육종 시, NpyFormin01 유전자의 발현 제어를 활용한 내열성 품종 개발 전략을 수립할 수 있다.
articles.abstract: Background/Objectives:Neopyropia yezoensis is an economically important intertidal red alga that frequently experiences fluctuations in temperature, light intensity, and water availability. Formins are key regulators of actin nucleation and cytoskeletal dynamics, but their functions and stress-responsive roles in red algae remain poorly understood. This study aimed to systematically identify and characterize the Formin gene family in N. yezoensis and investigate their expression responses to different environmental stresses. Methods: Formin family members were identified from the N. yezoensis genome using HMMER and BLAST (2.17.0) searches based on the conserved FH2 domain, followed by domain validation. Gene structures, conserved motifs, physicochemical properties, predicted subcellular localization, protein structures, chromosomal distribution, phylogenetic relationships, and cis-acting elements in the upstream regions were analyzed. The expression patterns of the identified Formin genes were further examined by qRT-PCR under different temperature (4, 10, and 24 °C), light intensity (20, 60, and 100 μmol photons m-2 s-1), and desiccation/rehydration conditions. Results: Three Formin genes, designated NpyFormin01-03, were identified in N. yezoensis. All three encoded proteins contained the conserved FH2 domain but differed in motif composition, domain architecture, predicted subcellular localization, and structural features. NpyFormin01 contained additional PTEN_C2 and PTP_DSP_cys domains, whereas NpyFormin02 and NpyFormin03 contained only the FH2 domain. Phylogenetic analysis showed that the N. yezoensis Formins clustered with Formins from other red algae. Promoter analysis identified multiple predicted cis-acting elements associated with light, temperature, environmental, and phytohormone responses. Expression analysis revealed distinct responses among the three genes under the tested environmental conditions. Notably, NpyFormin01 was significantly upregulated under high-temperature treatment (24 °C), whereas NpyFormin02 and NpyFormin03 showed no statistically significant expression changes under the tested conditions. Conclusions: This study provides a systematic characterization of the Formin gene family in N. yezoensis. The differences in protein architecture, structural features, promoter cis-acting elements, and environmental-responsive expression patterns suggest potential functional divergence among NpyFormins. In particular, NpyFormin01 represents a potential heat-responsive candidate gene and may contribute to cytoskeletal regulation during environmental stress adaptation in N. yezoensis. These findings provide a basis for further investigation of the molecular functions of Formins in red algae.

articles.headline: 캘리포니아만 고유 홍조류 Neoporphyra hollenbergii 미토콘드리아 게놈 최초 해독
articles.title: The complete mitochondrial genome of
articles.authors: Ceballos G, Muñiz-Salazar R, León-Cisneros K, Serviere-Zaragoza E et al.
takeaways: 캘리포니아만 지역의 숨은 다양성을 지닌 고유 홍조류 Neoporphyra hollenbergii의 미토콘드리아 유전체 정보는 그간 공백 상태였습니다.
해독된 환형 미토콘드리아 게놈은 31,565 bp 크기에 30.6%의 GC 함량을 보이며, 단백질 코딩 22개를 포함해 총 50개의 유전자로 구성되었습니다.
cox1과 rnl 유전자의 인트론 존재로 홍조류 미토콘드리아의 복잡성이 확인되었으며, 계통분석을 통해 N. perforata와 자매군임을 밝혀 진화 과정을 규명했습니다.
articles.implications: 이번에 확보된 유전체 및 계통발생 데이터는 멕시코만 일대 방사무늬김목(Bangiales) 자원의 분자생물학적 식별 표준으로 활용되어, 향후 지역 특산 해조류의 품종 개량 및 병해 관리 등 육종 프로그램의 기초 자료로 활용될 수 있습니다.
articles.abstract: Neoporphyra hollenbergii is an endemic red alga from the Gulf of California, a region with notable cryptic diversity. We report its first complete mitochondrial genome and the first Bangiales mitogenome from the region. The circular mitogenome measures 31,565 bp (30.6% GC) and contains 50 genes, including 22 protein-coding genes, two rRNA genes, 24 tRNA genes, tatC, and orf813. The cox1 and rnl genes contain introns, reflecting red algal mitogenome complexity, while gene organization is conserved across Neoporphyra. Phylogenetic analyses place N. hollenbergii sister to N. perforata, clarifying regional Bangiales mitochondrial evolution.

articles.headline: 대부도산 방사무늬다시마 고온 적응성의 유전적 메커니즘 규명
articles.title: Genome-Guided and De Novo Transcriptome Analysis of a Newly Isolated
articles.authors: Choi J, Kim J
takeaways: 기후변화에 대응하는 고온 내성 품종 개발을 위해 대부도에서 분리된 방사무늬다시마(Neopyropia yezoensis) 신규 균주의 유전적 및 분자적 특성을 분석했습니다.
다양한 온도에서 배양된 샘플의 전사체 분석 결과, 정렬된 리드와 정렬되지 않은 리드에서 각각 45,089개와 105,750개의 전사체가 조립되었습니다.
고온에서 발현이 증가한 유전자 중에는 해당작용과 광합성뿐만 아니라 열쇼크 단백질, 신장 인자 1 알파 등이 포함되어 고온 스트레스 대응에 기여함을 확인했습니다.
articles.implications: 현장 양식가와 육종 연구자들은 이번에 발굴된 고온 내성 관련 차등 발현 유전자(DEG) 정보를 활용하여 기후변화 속에서도 안정적으로 생장할 수 있는 고부가가치 신품종 육성에 즉각 착수해야 합니다.
articles.abstract:
[BACKGROUND] The escalating threats of global warming and the increasing demand for sustainable resources have driven research towards identifying resilient organisms capable of thriving under changing environmental conditions. A recently identified strain of Neopyropia yezoensis from Daebudo has demonstrated the ability to grow even under elevated temperatures. Understanding the genetic and molecular mechanisms underlying this resilience is crucial for the development of heat-tolerant cultivars.

[METHODS] This study investigates the characteristics of the newly isolated strain N. yezoensis (Daebudo) through comprehensive transcriptome analysis on samples cultivated at various temperatures. Transcript reads were aligned to the genome sequences of N. yezoensis (susabi-nori) and Neoporphyra haitanensis. Aligned and unaligned reads were assembled separately, generating 45,089 transcripts and 105,750 transcripts, respectively. The transcripts were annotated using homologous sequences from the Swiss-Prot, NCBI NR, Pfam, SignalP, and KEGG databases. Differentially expressed gene (DEG) analysis was performed, and gene function classification (Gene Ontology) was conducted using BLASTX and BLASTP results from the Swiss-Prot database.

[RESULTS] Some transcripts that were upregulated under higher temperatures were found to be involved in key metabolic pathways such as glycolysis or photosynthesis. Also, several DEGs, including heat shock proteins and elongation factor 1 alpha, were identified as potential contributors to high-temperature tolerance. These DEGs are likely involved in cellular stress response and protein synthesis, facilitating growth under elevated temperatures.

[CONCLUSION] The findings provide new molecular-level insights into the growth mechanisms of N. yezoensis under heat stress. This information can be applied to the development of new cultivars with enhanced growth and heat tolerance, supporting sustainable aquaculture in the face of climate change.

articles.headline: 자외선-B 스트레스에서 방사무늬새우말 암수의 광합성 및 대사 차이
articles.title: Sex-related differences in photosynthesis, energy metabolism, and antioxidant regulation of Neoporphyra haitanensis to ultraviolet-B stress
articles.authors: Xue S, Chen J, Xin J, Liang S et al.
takeaways: 인간 활동으로 증가한 자외선-B가 해조류의 성별에 따른 스트레스 반응에 미치는 영향은 그동안 거의 알려지지 않았습니다.
자외선-B 노출 결과 암컷은 광합성 색소와 활성이 크게 저하되고 활성산소와 말론디알데히드가 증가한 반면, 수컷은 더 강한 항산화 효소 활성과 에너지 대사 능력을 보였습니다.
이번 연구는 방사무늬새우말의 자외선-B 스트레스 및 회복 과정에서 나타나는 광합성, 에너지 대사, 항산화 조절의 뚜렷한 성별 차이를 확인했습니다.
articles.implications: 양식 현장에서는 자외선 수준 변화에 따른 종내 성별 취약성을 고려하여 품종 개량 및 양식장 관리 전략을 차별화해야 하며, 기후변화 대응 모델 구축 시 성별 생리 특성 데이터를 필수적으로 반영해야 합니다.
articles.abstract: Increased ultraviolet-B (UVB) radiation due to human activities poses a considerable threat to all exposed organisms. While sex-related differences in stress responses have been observed in many plant species, little is known about whether such differences exist in macroalgae. In this study, we investigated the physiological, transcriptomic, and metabolomic responses of male and female Neoporphyra haitanensis under UVB stress and subsequent recovery. The physiological results indicated that UVB stress strongly inhibited the photosynthetic pigment content and activity in females compared to those in males. Consequently, females exhibited higher levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde (MDA) production under UVB stress and recovery. In contrast, males exhibited stronger antioxidant enzyme activity to alleviate the oxidative stress under UVB stress. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that UVB caused a greater downregulation of genes related to pigment synthesis, photosystems, and carbon fixation in females, including genes encoding magnesium protoporphyrin IX methyltransferase (ChlM), phycoerythrin (PE), and glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH). Furthermore, males possessed a stronger photosynthetic recovery capacity, as a greater number of photosynthesis-related genes were significantly upregulated in males after recovery. Under UVB stress, the expression of genes encoding key enzymes involved in glycolysis, the pentose phosphate pathway, and the tricarboxylic acid cycle was higher in males than in females, indicating a stronger energy metabolism capacity in males. Metabolomic data emphasized the protective role of nonenzymatic antioxidants, particularly flavonoids, with females accumulating more methylated flavonoids and flavonoid glycosides after recovery than males. Overall, these findings highlight sex-related differences in photosynthesis, energy metabolism, and antioxidant regulation in N. haitanensis under UVB stress and recovery. These results contribute to our understanding of how sex differences in macroalgae influence their population survival under increased UVB radiation and provide insights into their potential adaptive responses to ongoing climate change.

articles.headline: 침입 해조류 추출물을 활용한 토마토 역병 방제 및 면역 강화
articles.title: From sea to farm: Repurposing invasive macroalgae into biocidal and defense-enhancing tools against tomato late blight (Phytophthora infestans)
articles.authors: Laureano G, Fonseca B, Carreiras J, Felix C et al.
articles.journal: Plant science : an international journal of experimental plant biology
takeaways: 저비용 친환경 농업 자재 확보와 생태계 교란 생물 문제 해결을 동시에 달성하기 위해 아스파라곱시스 아마타와 사가숨 무티쿰 등 침입 해조류의 농업적 활용 가능성에 주목했다.
토마토에 조추출물을 처리한 결과 광화학 에너지 분포, 막 지질 조성, 산화환원 균형 및 이차 대사 과정이 조절되어 식물 방어력이 향상되었으며, 특히 아스파라곱시스 아마타가 더욱 강력한 반응을 유도했다.
해조류 추출물은 병원균의 활동을 억제하는 동시에 기주 식물의 방어 체계를 활성화함으로써 감염 기간 동안 식물의 회복력을 높여 지속 가능한 생물학적 방제제로 기능할 수 있다.
articles.implications: 해양 생태계를 위협하는 침입 해조류를 수거해 고부가가치 농업용 방제 자재로 업사이클링함으로써, 폐기물 처리 비용 절감과 친환경 농약 대체 효과를 동시에 거두는 현장 적용형 자원 순환 모델을 구축할 수 있다.
articles.abstract: Marine seaweeds are increasingly recognized as sources of bioactive compounds with potential applications in sustainable agriculture, including as biocontrol agents. The selection of invasive species such as Asparagopsis armata and Sargassum muticum offers a dual benefit: obtaining bioactive metabolites from a low-cost resource while simultaneously mitigating their ecological impacts using this harmful biomass. In the present study, crude extracts from A. armata and S. muticum were applied to tomato plants and were effective as biocontrol agents against Phytophthora infestans. Treatments modulated key physiological and metabolic processes, including photochemical energy distribution, membrane lipid composition, redox balance, and secondary metabolism, effectively eliciting plants for enhanced defense. Asparagopsis armata elicited particularly strong responses, whereas S. muticum induced moderate but consistent effects across multiple pathways. These changes were correlated with the pathogen inoculation outcome and improved plant resilience during infection. These findings provide physiological insights into how these macroalgae can suppress pathogen activity while enhancing host defenses, highlighting their potential as sustainable biocontrol agents. Exploiting A. armata and S. muticum in this context presents a resource-efficient biocontrol strategy that links plant adjuvant defense enhancer effect with the valorization of underexploited marine biomass, reinforcing their potential within sustainable agricultural systems.

articles.headline: 메탄 저감 제제에 따른 반추위 미생물 군집의 DNA·RNA·vDNA 비교 분석
articles.title: Comparative metataxonomic analysis of total, viable, and active rumen microbial communities under methane-mitigated conditions
articles.authors: Lee W, Kim G, Li W, Park T
takeaways: 반추위 미생물 연구 시 사세 세포의 신호를 배제하고 생존성과 활성을 정확히 평가하기 위해 총 DNA, PMA 처리 DNA, RNA 기반의 분석법을 비교했습니다.
모넨신(MON) 처리가 가장 뚜렷한 발효 및 미생물 조성 변화를 유도한 반면, RNA 프로파일은 가장 낮은 알파 다양성을 보였고 파라박테로이데스는 vDNA에서 상대적 풍부도가 유의하게 높았습니다.
PMA 처리 DNA는 손상된 세포의 신호를 줄이고 기존 DNA와 RNA에서 포착되지 않던 막 무결성 세포군을 드러내어 RNA 분석의 기술적 한계를 보완할 수 있습니다.
articles.implications: 현장 연구자들은 RNA 추출이 까다로운 반추위 샘플 분석 시 PMA 처리 DNA(vDNA)를 대안적 방법으로 활용하여 생존 미생물 군집을 더욱 신뢰성 있게 평가할 수 있습니다.
articles.abstract:
[BACKGROUND] The rumen microbiota play a central role in digestion and methane production, thereby influencing ruminant productivity. Evaluating methane mitigation strategies requires consideration of both microbial viability and activity. DNA-based methods may include signals from dead or damaged cells, whereas RNA-based approaches may underrepresent viable populations with low transcriptional activity. Propidium monoazide (PMA) reduces DNA signals from membrane-compromised cells, providing an indirect, membrane-integrity-based assessment of microbial viability. This study compared taxonomic and predicted functional profiles obtained by 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing of total DNA (tDNA), PMA-treated DNA (vDNA), and RNA-derived cDNA (RNA) from rumen samples subjected to three in vitro methane mitigation treatments: 3-nitrooxypropanol (NOP), monensin (MON), and Asparagopsis sp. (ASP).

[RESULTS] MON treatment induced the most pronounced changes in fermentation parameters and microbial composition, whereas the NOP and ASP groups exhibited similar fermentation outcomes. RNA-derived profiles exhibited the lowest alpha diversity, with vDNA profiles falling between those of RNA and tDNA. Procrustes analysis revealed metric-dependent similarities among sample types; Bray-Curtis distances showed closer alignment between tDNA and RNA, whereas Jaccard distances showed greater similarity between vDNA and RNA. Parabacteroides exhibited significantly higher relative abundance in vDNA than in tDNA or RNA. Notably, Succiniclasticum showed opposing correlations with the acetate-to-propionate ratio between tDNA and RNA under MON treatment, whereas no significant correlation was detected in vDNA. Differential analysis of PICRUSt2-predicted methanogenesis-related KEGG modules revealed sample type- and treatment-specific patterns.

[CONCLUSIONS] PMA-treated DNA provided a distinct perspective on the rumen microbiota by reducing signals from membrane-compromised cells and revealing populations that were differently represented in tDNA and RNA-derived profiles, including membrane-intact populations with low RNA representation. Thus, vDNA may serve as a practical additional approach when RNA analysis is technically constrained.

articles.headline: 인도 방목 가축 시스템의 사료·물 부족 해결과 아스파라고옵시스 등 저탄소 해조류의 메탄 저감 효과 분석
articles.title: Challenges and sustainable solutions in multispecies extensive livestock production systems across India's agroclimatic zones
articles.authors: Yadav D, Maletha D, Puniya A, Mojjada S et al.
takeaways: 인도 전역 15개 기후대의 방목 가축 시스템이 직면한 사료 부족, 물 스트레스, 기후 변화 간의 복합적 상호작용을 분석하고자 시스템 접근법을 도입했다.
사료 부족과 물 부족이 상호작용하여 가뭄 피해를 1.5~2배 증폭시키며, 아스파라고옵시스 해조류 등의 식이 첨가물은 반추동물의 장내 메탄을 최대 98%까지 줄이는 것으로 나타났다.
전통적 지식과 현대적 기술을 융합한 자원 효율성 향상과 기후대별 최적 개입 패키지를 통합한 의사결정 지원 매트릭스가 지속 가능한 전환의 핵심이다.
articles.implications: 현장 양식가와 정책 담당자는 35도 이상의 폭염과 30%를 초과하는 사료 부족 지역에서 내열성 품종(칸크레즈 소, 바르바리 염소) 도입과 전통 수자원 관리 기법을 즉각 결합해야 하며, 메탄 감축 목표 달성을 위해 아스파라고옵시스 등 해조류 사료 첨가제 보급의 현장 실증을 서둘러야 한다.
articles.abstract:
Extensive livestock production systems support over 70 million rural households across India's 15 agroclimatic zones, yet face interconnected challenges of feed scarcity (national deficits of approximately 11-32% for green fodder, 23% for dry fodder, and 29-40% for concentrates, with localized winter shortages reaching ~ 68% in some humid zones), water stress (intensifying under climate change), inadequate veterinary coverage, and welfare compromises. This review adopts a systems analysis approach to examine feed-water-health-welfare-climate interactions across multiple species (cattle, buffalo, sheep, goat, camel) in ecologically diverse production environments.

[METHODS] We synthesized evidence from approximately 350 sources and field innovations to develop an integrated framework mapping resource flows, constraint interactions, and adaptive capacity across zones. We synthesized reported trade-offs between productivity enhancement, emissions mitigation, and welfare improvement based on evidence reported across studies.

[KEY SYSTEMS FINDINGS] Literature consistently reports that feed and water constraints interact non-additively in zones with > 30% feed deficit with several studies reporting approximately 1.5-2-fold amplification of drought impacts on productivity. These values represent reported ranges synthesized conceptually rather than a pooled statistical estimate. Indigenous innovations (Johads, chauka systems, ethno-veterinary practices) yield 30-40% gains in resource efficiency when integrated with modern inputs in arid/semi-arid cattle-goat systems (Pankaj et al. 2023; Kanwal et al. 2020). Species-zone matching shows thermal-tolerant breeds maintain 15-20% higher productivity (Kankrej cattle, Barbari goats) than crossbreeds under heat stress (> 35 °C) (Sarang et al. 2024; Sejian et al. 2019; Das 2017). Dietary additives reduce enteric methane by 17-98%, ranging from tannin-rich forages (~ 17-20%) to Asparagopsis seaweed (up to ~ 98% under in vitro/in vivo conditions) in small ruminants and cattle (Verma and Kumar Verma 2025; Mwangi et al. 2023; Amad and Zentek 2023).

[SYSTEMS INTEGRATION FRAMEWORK] We propose a conceptual decision-support matrix integrating breed selection, feed management, water harvesting, and veterinary delivery across 15 zones, identifying optimal intervention packages. Zone-specific vulnerability indices highlight critical thresholds based on synthesized evidence from the literature. Arid zones (13-14) are reported to experience compounding welfare and productivity decline when summer temperatures exceed approximately 42 °C for extended periods (in the order of 90 days), consistent with heat-stress thresholds documented in the literature (Sejian et al. 2019; Mishra et al. 2024).

[IMPLICATIONS] Sustainable transformation requires synergistic implementation of traditional knowledge and technological innovation, gender-inclusive extension (women provide 50% plus labor) and policy frameworks addressing cross-scale interactions. Research gaps include empirical validation of welfare indicators, emission baselines for indigenous breeds, and community-based institutional models. Our integrated framework enables evidence-based resource allocation and supports India's climate commitments while enhancing rural livelihoods.

articles.headline: 기후변화 속 포르투갈 조간대 해조류 군집의 기능적 재편
articles.title: When thermal shifts reshape function in intertidal seaweeds communities
articles.authors: Martins M, Arenas F, Lindegren M, Vale C et al.
takeaways: 포르투갈 북부 조간대 대형해조류 군집을 대상으로 2006~2008년과 2021~2024년 사이의 시간적 추세와 기능적 특성 변화를 조사했습니다.
평균 군집 온도 지수(CTI)는 안정세를 유지했으나, 저온 적응성 종의 증감과 아스파라고프시스(Asparagopsis armata) 같은 침입종의 등장으로 상당한 군집 교체와 기능적 특성 변화가 발생했습니다.
라미나리아 오크롤레우카(Laminaria ochroleuca)는 높은 기능적 독창성과 낮은 중복성을 보여 개체군 감소에 취약하며, 이러한 핵심 종의 보전이 생태계 회복력 유지에 필수적입니다.
articles.implications: 현장 양식가와 해양 정책 담당자는 단순한 수온 모니터링을 넘어, 라미나리아 같은 고유의 기능적 독창성을 가진 기초 종의 서식지 보호와 침입종 확산 방지를 결합한 맞춤형 블루카본 생태계 관리 전략을 즉시 수립해야 합니다.
articles.abstract: Climate-driven changes are reshaping marine communities worldwide, yet its functional consequences for intertidal macroalgae remain poorly resolved. We investigated temporal trends in community thermal affinity and functional trait composition of low intertidal macroalgae assemblages along the northern Portuguese coast over seven years spanning more than one decade (2006-2008, 2021-2024). Although mean Community Temperature Index (CTI) remained relatively stable, substantial community turnover occurred. This pattern was primarily driven by changes in the abundance of cold-affinity species, with deborealization and borealization contributing to observed shifts in thermal composition. Furthermore, we demonstrate pronounced temporal shifts in functional traits, including pigmentation, morphology, reproductive mode and structural complexity. Analyses of functional redundancy and originality showed that foundation species disproportionately shape community functional structure. More specifically, Laminaria ochroleuca exhibited high functional originality but low redundancy, indicating potential vulnerability to abundance declines. Community turnover, including the emergence of invasive species like Asparagopsis armata, further illustrates dynamic restructuring of functional space. Together, these results indicate that, despite apparent thermal stability, intertidal macroalgae communities are undergoing functional reorganization, with potential consequences for productivity, habitat complexity, and blue carbon capacity. Conserving functionally original and habitat-forming species is therefore critical for maintaining ecosystem resilience in the face of climate change.

articles.headline: 위성 데이터와 머신러닝으로 밝힌 허저우만 10년 엽록소-a 동역학과 김 양식의 연관성
articles.title: Long-term spatiotemporal variability and drivers of chlorophyll-a in Haizhou Bay using Sentinel-3 OLCI and multi-source data
articles.authors: Xie K, Qiao W, Wu L, Zhang S et al.
articles.category_name: 스마트 양식 및 대량 배양 기술
takeaways: 기후변화와 인간 활동이 심화되는 연안 생태계에서 식물플랑크톤 생체량과 부영양화 지표인 엽록소-a의 장기적 변동성을 파악하고자 했습니다.
랜덤 포레스트 모델이 결정계수 0.72와 로그 도메인 RMSE 0.66으로 가장 우수한 성능을 보였으며, 연평균 엽록소-a는 김 양식 면적과 높은 상관관계(r = 0.81)를 나타냈습니다.
2016년부터 2025년까지의 연속적인 시공간 데이터셋을 통해 연안의 엽록소-a가 김 양식, 영양염류 동역학, 녹조 현상과 밀접하게 연동되어 있음을 규명했습니다.
articles.implications: 현장 양식가와 정책 담당자는 이번에 구축된 고해상도 장기 데이터셋을 활용해 양식장 밀집 구역의 부영양화를 사전에 예측하고, 계절별 녹조 및 영양염류 유입에 대응하는 정밀한 연안 관리 전략을 수립해야 합니다.
articles.abstract: Global climate change is intensifying pressure on marine ecosystems, particularly coastal bays affected by natural variability and anthropogenic disturbances. Chlorophyll-a (Chl-a) is a key indicator of phytoplankton biomass and eutrophication status. This study investigated the spatiotemporal variability and potential drivers of Chl-a in Haizhou Bay during 2016-2025 by integrating Sentinel-3 Ocean and Land Colour Instrument (OLCI) imagery, in situ measurements, and multi-source ancillary data. Among the evaluated models, random forest showed the best overall performance and stability, outperforming support vector regression, extreme gradient boosting, and European Space Agency operational algorithms, with a coefficient of determination of 0.72 and a root mean square error of 0.66 in the logarithmic domain. The retrieved Chl-a fields were reconstructed into a spatiotemporally continuous 2016-2025 dataset for analyzing long-term dynamics and potential drivers. The principal contribution is the construction of this continuous dataset and its integration with environmental records to assess associations with mariculture activities, nearshore nutrient pressure, and episodic green-tide disturbances. Annual mean Chl-a initially increased, declined after 2019, and rebounded slightly in 2025, while remaining consistently higher nearshore than offshore. Chl-a peaked in May-June, and seasonal variability was associated with Pyropia cultivation, nutrient dynamics, and episodic green tides. Annual mean Chl-a was correlated with Pyropia cultivation area (r = 0.81, p < 0.01), whereas the areal proportion of high-Chl-a waters showed a positive but non-significant correlation with the eutrophication index (r = 0.63, p > 0.05). These findings provide a long-term evidence base for eutrophication control, mariculture management, and refined coastal management.

articles.headline: 홍조류 유래 화장품 성분 60종에 대한 안전성 평가 결과
articles.title: Safety Assessment of Red Algae-Derived Ingredients as Used in Cosmetics
articles.authors: Ferguson P, Bergfeld W, Belsito D, Cohen D et al.
takeaways: 국제 화장품 성분 사전(Dictionary)에 등록된 60종의 홍조류 유래 피부 컨디셔닝 성분을 대상으로 전문가 패널이 안전성을 평가했습니다.
평가 결과 16개 성분은 현재의 사용 관행과 농도에서 안전한 것으로 판명되었으나, 비소와 중금속 등의 불순물 관리가 강조되었습니다.
나머지 44개 성분에 대해서는 화장품 제형 내 사용 안전성을 판단하기에 가용 데이터가 불충분하다는 결론이 내려졌습니다.
articles.implications: 관련 업계는 비소나 중금속 같은 잔류 불순물을 통제하기 위해 우수제조관리기준(GMP)을 철저히 준수해야 하며, 데이터가 부족한 44개 성분에 대해서는 추가적인 안전성 입증 자료를 확보해야 합니다.
articles.abstract: The Expert Panel for Cosmetic Ingredient Safety (Panel) assessed the safety of red algae-derived ingredients. Sixty red algae-derived ingredients were found in the International Cosmetic Ingredient Dictionary (Dictionary); however, several of these ingredients may be equivalent according to accepted scientific names. These ingredients are mostly reported to function in cosmetics as skin-conditioning agents. Impurities, particularly arsenic, heavy metals, and pesticides, may be present in these ingredients; industry should continue to use good manufacturing practices to monitor and limit these possible impurities. The Panel considered the available data and concluded that 16 red algae-derived ingredients are safe in cosmetics in the present practices of use and concentration described in this safety assessment. The Panel also concluded that the data are insufficient to make a determination of safety that the remaining 44 ingredients are safe under the intended conditions of use in cosmetic formulations.

articles.headline: 해조류 펩타이드의 생리활성과 지속가능성, 그리고 산업적 한계
articles.title: Navigating the potential of algal peptides: health effects, market applications, and scientific challenges
articles.authors: Khaliq M, Noor Z, Moazzam M, Saeed F et al.
takeaways: 전통 단백질을 대체할 친환경 기능성 소재로서 해조류 유래 생리활성 펩타이드의 영양학적 가치와 건강 증진 효과를 종합적으로 평가하고자 문헌 조사를 수행했습니다.
Limnospira와 Neopyropia 등 다양한 조류에서 추출한 펩타이드는 효소 저해를 통한 혈압 및 대사 조절, 항산화·항염증 효과를 보였으며, 제한적인 인체 시험에서 혈압과 혈당 등 대사 지표의 유의미한 개선이 관찰되었습니다.
해조류 펩타이드는 지속가능한 영양 공급원으로 주목받으나, 복잡한 공정 비용과 불확실한 생체 이용률로 인해 임상 적용과 상용화에 한계가 있어 표준화된 생산과 추가 임상 연구가 필수적입니다.
articles.implications: 현장 양식가와 산업계는 에너지 집약적인 후처리 공정을 개선하고 표준화된 생산 체계를 구축해야 하며, 정책 담당자는 명확한 생체 이용률 검증과 대규모 인체 시험을 뒷받침할 규제 및 지원 방안을 마련해야 합니다.
articles.abstract:
[INTRODUCTION] Algae-derived bioactive peptides are gaining recognition as functional ingredients offering health benefits and sustainability advantages over conventional proteins. This review aimed to evaluate the current evidence on algal peptides, focusing on their nutritional content, mechanistic actions, health effects, potential for sustainability, and translational challenges.

[MATERIALS AND METHODS] A comprehensive literature search was conducted across PubMed, Scopus, ScienceDirect, Springer, Elsevier, and Google Scholar. Peer-reviewed studies reporting bioactive peptides derived from microalgae, macroalgae, or Cyanophyceae were included. In vitro, animal, and human intervention studies evaluating molecular mechanisms, metabolic outcomes, or clinical relevance were considered.

[RESULTS] Available evidence shows that algal peptides exert multifunctional bioactivities, including inhibition of angiotensin-converting enzyme and renin, antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, modulation of glucose metabolism via α-amylase, α-glucosidase, and DPP-IV inhibition, and regulation of lipid metabolism and adipogenesis. Frequently studied sources included Limnospira, Chlorella, Auxenochlorella, Nannochloropsis, Undaria, Palmaria, Ulva, and Neopyropia. Limited human trials suggest modest but clinically relevant improvements in blood pressure, glycemic control, lipid profiles, and body-weight-related outcomes, primarily using whole algal biomass or extracts. Life-cycle assessments highlight favorable land-use efficiency and carbon sequestration potential, although economic feasibility is constrained by energy-intensive downstream processing.

[CONCLUSION] Algal-derived peptides demonstrate promising health-promoting effects and align with sustainable nutrition goals. However, their clinical translation is limited by variability in peptide characterization, uncertain bioavailability, and lack of robust human trials. Standardized production methods, improved delivery strategies, comprehensive safety assessments, and well-designed clinical studies are essential to support their application in functional foods and nutraceuticals.
